statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (canvas '67r', the right-hand wheel of the two; overview and one full-resolution crop of the interior). A circle with 12 sectors of writing and a rim of 12 red labels; in the centre an eight-rayed yellow star on a scalloped rosette; between them a ring of 12 small face-discs, each with a crescent painted red or yellow. Clockwise from the top the crescent colours run red, yellow, red, yellow, yellow, red, red, yellow, red, yellow, red, yellow (6 red, 6 yellow). Labels assigned from line ids and unit codes only, words not read: the 12 Ls lines f67r2.52-63 are given to the 12 discs clockwise from the one at the top; the starting point is my assumption, so label ids may be rotated by a constant. The rim labels and the words round the star are noted on the wheel and star but point at no separate drawn object.

features.background: scalloped rosette on a green square wash
features.note: eight long pointed rays, yellow-tan with a row of dots along each, laid over a round rosette of scalloped lobes with a faint blue-green square behind; a dotted line runs out to the left from one ray; a ring of about eight short words surrounds it (label lines f67r2.64-71), none tied to a separate drawing

features.colour: uncoloured with red writing on the rim
features.note: circle divided by radial lines into 12 sectors, each holding a few short lines of writing; an outer rim band carries 12 short labels in red ink (label lines f67r2.1-12, one per sector) separated by groups of tick marks; three long lines of writing below the wheel, the middle one in red
